title: Outcome ledger rotation + retention policy — per-domain JSONL hygiene
rationale: 13 domain chats emit OutcomeLedgerRecord JSONL hourly. Without rotation: <domain>-outcomes.jsonl grows unboundedly, query latency degrades, retrain ingest takes minutes instead of seconds. Need weekly rotation + 90-day retention + S3-equivalent archive.

units.title: training-ledger-rotate.mjs — rotates state/shared/training/<domain>-outcomes.jsonl to dated archive weekly
Rotation cron — fires every Sunday 03:15 local (PRISM Outcome Ledger Rotation scheduled task)
Retention policy — keep last 13 weeks online + archive older to .gz
Audit hook — verify processLedger reads from BOTH live + archive when --since flag given
Telemetry — record rotation stats (lines rotated, archive bytes) per ledger

exit_gate.rotation_proven: live ledger never exceeds 7 days of outcomes
exit_gate.no_data_loss: all rotated rows accounted for in archive byte-count audit
exit_gate.cron_health: scheduled task has 4+ successful runs (≥1 month of live operation)

summary: Rotate per-domain outcome ledgers weekly, retain 13 weeks online, archive older as gzipped JSONL. Required before fleet-wide training stabilizes — otherwise ingest performance degrades and retrains slow to minutes per run.
